question:
The below data gives the number of boys and girls in class V, Class VI, Class VII and Class VIII.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/905694a7a4a0bc1d6fd22b485a856c04ce2199a3c1759a2b5978fb0380ad655a.png] 

Which class has maximum number of students?
solution:
**Calculation:**

The total number of students in class 5 is , 65 + 58 = 123

The total number of students in class 6 is , 59 + 57 =116

The total number of students in class 7 is , 60 + 62 = 122

The total number of students in class 8 is , 61 + 59 = 120

**Class V has the maximum number of students.**
